connector.name: Python MCP
connector.registryDescription: Securely give LLMs controlled access to real-world operations inside your Files.com environment
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package files-com-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.files. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FILES_COM_API_KEY
env.description: Optional fallback Files.com API Key. In HTTP/SSE mode, you can pass x-filesapi-key per request.
